defects.title: Transitory Pagefind Build Lock Collision in Parallel Test Suite
defects.rootCause: Concurrent vitest worker processes attempting to write to same dist directory simultaneously.
defects.fixApplied: Configured vitest.config.ts with fileParallelism: false and atomic temp-file renaming on all JSON stores.

defects.title: Unused uuid Import in Topical Authority Planner
defects.rootCause: Unused external package import causing module resolution warning in isolated test runner.
defects.fixApplied: Removed unused package import in favor of crypto.randomBytes / timestamp ID generation.

defects.title: FailurePoint RiskLevel Type Narrowing in Architecture Audit
defects.rootCause: Architecture node failurePoint specified LOW risk level which was omitted from Zod union.
